method: Targeted primary-source review of Legistar direct bill-number/title search, discovered report/GUID links, historical attachment conventions, City Clerk publication material, and the prior substitute reconciliation. A final enactment is not inferred from a blank enactment line, a later transaction, or an introduced attachment.
